mapper.sql: CASE WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(m.name) <= 1 THEN '*' WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(m.name) = 2 THEN CONCAT(LEFT(m.name, 1), '*') ELSE CONCAT(LEFT(m.name, 1), REPEAT('*', CHAR_LENGTH(m.name) - 2), RIGHT(m.name, 1)) END

FROM members m JOIN region r ON r.region_id = m.region_id
m.deleted_at IS NULL
AND (m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND m.account_status = #{accountStatus}
AND r.region_name LIKE CONCAT(#{regionName}, '%')
mapper.select:
SELECT m.member_id, AS name, m.nickname, AS email, r.region_name, m.account_status, m.identity_verified_at, m.region_verified_at, m.created_at
ORDER BY m.created_at DESC, m.member_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT m.member_id, AS name, m.nickname, AS email, CASE WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(m.phone) >= 7 THEN CONCAT(LEFT(m.phone, 3), '-****-', RIGHT(m.phone, 4)) ELSE '***' END AS phone, m.birth_date, m.gender, r.region_name, m.user_level, m.system_role, m.account_status, m.identity_verified_at, m.region_verified_at, m.created_at, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT gm.group_id) FROM group_member gm WHERE gm.member_id = m.member_id AND gm.membership_status = 'APPROVED') AS joined_group_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post p WHERE p.writer_id = m.member_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL) AS written_post_count FROM members m JOIN region r ON r.region_id = m.region_id WHERE m.member_id = #{memberId} AND m.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT m.member_id, m.account_status, mfr.restriction_scope, mfr.restricted_until FROM members m LEFT JOIN member_feature_restriction mfr ON mfr.member_id = m.member_id AND mfr.restriction_scope = #{restrictionScope} WHERE m.member_id = #{memberId} AND m.deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
SELECT restriction_scope, restricted_until FROM member_feature_restriction WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY restriction_scope
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM member_feature_restriction WHERE restricted_until IS NOT NULL AND restricted_until <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO restriction_history ( member_id, saving_group_id, action, restriction_type, restriction_scope, reason, restricted_until ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, NULL, #{action}, #{restrictionType}, #{restrictionScope}, #{reason}, #{restrictedUntil} )
